scope: Committed-source and documentation verification only; no runtime execution or conformance certification

features.boundary: Bounded shared ZIP codec, ZIP64 read, owned bytes and package writing; no encrypted/multi-disk admission promise.
Content types, relationships and bounded graph operations; unknown references can block mutation/import.
Macro-free Transitional presentation/template/show creation; Strict read/MCE handling exists, but Strict creation and mixed-dialect import reject. No universal Strict edit claim.
Namespace-aware parsing, compatibility view and bounded XML replacement with explicit validation limits; opaque branches retained, unsupported required namespaces reject.
Ordered slides, graph, hashes, locations and bounded style provenance; no complete semantic census.
Original blank master/layout and structured text slides; supplied-template creation rejects.
Add/move/name/hide/remove/duplicate with supported reference policies; opaque dependencies can reject.
Bounded dependency closure and deterministic remapping; conflicting notes masters, table styles, fonts, mixed dialects and unsupported references reject.
Names/order and supported membership; sections require contiguous nonoverlapping membership.
Canvas, number start, loop and show mode; restricted explicit scaling. Grid/view/print settings otherwise retained.
Create/rename, supported text/shapes/backgrounds with explicit shared scope; not arbitrary master editing.
Create/edit/apply/remove unreferenced layouts, explicit type/index mapping; ambiguity rejects.
Existing palette/font slots and overrides, bounded effective text provenance; no complete effective-style resolver.
Solid/linear RGB gradient/picture and inherited backgrounds; advanced effects retained.
Logical paragraph/run/break/field order and explicit notes/master scopes; no visual order or fine-grained selector completeness.
Literal cross-run replacement within paragraphs; fields/breaks stop matches, explicit cardinality, no normalization.
Local run formatting and shared font model; unset/inherited values remain distinct. Not full rendering fidelity.
Local spacing/alignment/indent/bullets/numbering/RTL/tabs; no layout engine.
Insets/columns/wrap/rotation/autofit metadata; fit uses supplied scalar metrics and bounded horizontal single-column text.
Logical Unicode replacement and direction/language metadata; shaping, fallback and visual bidi remain unverified.
Cached field text with explicit caller text/time; no automatic field evaluation.
Text boxes/presets and supported identity/geometry/format metadata; unsupported geometry/effects remain bounded.
Integer EMU move/line/quadratic/cubic/close and live builder; bounded commands, no arbitrary formula/winding evaluation.
Parent-coordinate geometry and restricted grouping/ungrouping with tolerance; unsafe transformed geometry rejects.
Explicit sibling order/alignment/distribution/duplication; locked or unsupported referenced objects reject.
Straight/elbow/curved connectors, bounded sites and detach/remove policies; arbitrary routing and rotated coordinate edits unsupported.
Solid/gradient/pattern/picture fills, lines/alpha/simple shadows; advanced stacks, DAGs and 3D retained.
Rectangular grid, text/format/sizes; direct CLI uses row,column and fails shared B2 grammar.
Rectangular spans, split, explicit insertion/deletion conflict policies; not arbitrary malformed-span repair.
Occurrences/unique parts, hashes, crop/geometry/alt text, inherited scopes and inert targets.
PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/placeable-WMF byte admission with bounded metadata/sizing; no native decoder.
Template image bindings provide a bounded replacement path; standalone images replace is absent at this commit. Uncommitted implementation is excluded.
Contain/cover/stretch, crop/rotation/flips/opacity/solid border/alt text; positive visible area required on crop edits.
Retain vector/fallback bytes; placeable-WMF admission is a specific exception, not general SVG/EMF decoding/editing.
Exact original bytes with safe names/manifests; explicit transactional or partial publication required.
Bounded category/XY/bubble families and live object edits; unsupported extensions retained, not arbitrary chart creation.
Live titles/legend/axes/ticks/plots/series/markers/labels/font/drawing subsets; case-by-case payload review remains open.
Simple embedded data/cache/range synchronization and builders; no formula evaluation or external data fetch.
Unsupported chartEx/advanced substructures retained; no silent conversion or full semantic editing claim.
Diagram resource graph/fallback inventory and supported import closure; no semantic layout engine.
OMML inspection/extraction and validated authored insertion; set/remove/typesetting/evaluation unavailable.
Explicit inert bytes/posters, insertion/replacement/extraction and metadata; no playback/transcoding proof.
Caption/track metadata inventory and retention; uncommitted track-editing work excluded, no independent playback evidence.
Cut/fade/push/wipe and explicit timing; unsupported/Morph/sound content retained.
Timing nodes/triggers/targets inspected without execution; not playback equivalence.
Appear/fade-in/fade-out/pulse, simple triggers/sequences; complex timelines retained and unsafe edits rejected.
Ordinary URL/slide navigation; other actions inert and retained, never executed.
Speaker body and explicit scoped notes/master text; competing master imports reject and whole live notes API remains incomplete.
Handout inventory and explicit master text replacement, notes size; print/view retained without pagination.
Legacy comments with explicit author/time/position; modern threads/mentions/reactions retained.
Core/typed custom properties and supported tags; unknown/custom XML retained, shared tag edits reject.
Alt/decorative metadata, title checks and structural order; no accessibility certification or contrast/visual-order proof.
Opaque inventory/extraction plus inert OLE byte insertion; controls/web/3D preserved without activation or recursive parsing.
Font declarations and embedded bytes inventoried/retained; no installation, rendering or license assurance.
Marker detection and bounded mutation refusal; no cryptographic validity, full rights interpretation or complete signature-removal claim.
Explicit supported property removal only at this commit; broad sanitization work in the working tree is excluded.
Explicit text/fixed-table/image bindings and repeated slides; not create --template support.
Ordered animation add/set/remove only; general property/model batches and handles unavailable.
Structural/text/media/relationship/raw-format differences; effective-formatting mode rejects, no visual diff.
Explicit bounded extract/pack/XML replacement and semantic validation; validator says schema not-checked, standalone validate CLI remains a gap.
